{{Top|leg}}
'''"I'm Just His Satellite"''' was a song performed by [[Princess/Legends|Princess]] [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa]] when she was posing as [[Shirley]], the "[[Chanteuse of the Stars/Legends|Chanteuse of the Stars]]."

==Lyrics==
Like a meteor cutting across a starless night<br />
He brightens up my darkest hour<br />
He's gentle and he's true<br />
Never tries to force me, oh, no<br />

And so I follow him<br />
Like the tail of a comet<br />
I'm just his satellite, yeah<br />
Never stray into any other orbit<br />
Not while he's around<br />

I'm empty when he's away from me<br />
My heart's a black hole<br />
Because he's the one who makes my skies a heaven<br />
No nothing will ever eclipse our love<br />
